help.t.firstSignin.title: Signing in for the first time
help.t.firstSignin.summary: How sign-in works, what to do if you land on the verification screen, and how to get to your dashboard.
help.t.firstSignin.s0: Click 'Sign in' on the landing page or hit /login directly.
help.t.firstSignin.s1: You'll be redirected to Keycloak — use the email and password you registered with.
help.t.firstSignin.s2: After sign-in, you'll see the onboarding screen if you haven't completed it before.
help.t.firstSignin.s3: If your email isn't verified yet, you'll be asked to enter the 6-digit OTP we email you.
help.t.firstSignin.s4: Once both onboarding and verification are done, you land on the dashboard.
help.t.firstSignin.tip0: Onboarding and verification are one-time. If you're being asked again on every login, your DB row may have an outdated keycloak_id — check with support.
help.t.onboardingFields.title: Onboarding — store name, mobile, seller type
help.t.onboardingFields.summary: Three quick fields that set up your storefront. Confirmation popup before saving.
help.t.onboardingFields.s0: Enter your store name (≥ 2 chars). It becomes the public-facing label on shared links.
help.t.onboardingFields.s1: Type your 10-digit Indian mobile number (must start with 6, 7, 8, or 9).
help.t.onboardingFields.s2: Pick a seller type — 'Individual' (one-person shop) or 'Social' (Instagram / WhatsApp resellers).
help.t.onboardingFields.s3: Click Continue → review the summary popup → confirm to save.
help.t.onboardingFields.tip0: Read the Terms & Conditions before confirming — link is in the footer of the onboarding screen.
help.t.onboardingFields.tip1: You can change the store name and mobile later from Settings.
help.t.addProduct.title: Adding a new product
help.t.addProduct.summary: Name, cost, selling price, photos — minimum to publish a product.
help.t.addProduct.s1: Fill basic info: name, description, status (Active / Inactive).
help.t.addProduct.s2: Pricing: enter cost, shipping, packaging — the app computes total cost. Optionally enter the competitor price + your selling price.
help.t.addProduct.s3: Upload up to 6 photos. Drag-and-drop or click. Mark a 'main' image — it's the one shown to customers first.
help.t.addProduct.s4: Click 'Save Product'. You're returned to the products list.
help.t.addProduct.tip0: Selling price below total cost shows a warning but is allowed (clearance pricing).
help.t.addProduct.tip1: Discount % is computed against the competitor price, not the cost — set it for the savings to show.
help.t.editProduct.title: Editing or deactivating a product
help.t.editProduct.summary: Change details, replace photos, or hide a product without deleting it.
help.t.editProduct.s0: On Products, click the Edit icon on a product card.
help.t.editProduct.s1: Update any field. Existing photos load automatically — pick new files only if you want to replace.
help.t.editProduct.s2: Toggle status to 'Inactive' to hide the product from your storefront without losing it.
help.t.editProduct.tip0: Inactive products don't show up on your public store but you can still create dynamic-price links from them.
help.t.dynamicPricing.title: Dynamic pricing — one-time price links
help.t.dynamicPricing.summary: Send a custom-priced link to a single customer (gift items, custom orders, quotes).
help.t.dynamicPricing.s1: Pick a base product. Name and description come from the master record.
help.t.dynamicPricing.s2: Set the one-time price for this customer.
help.t.dynamicPricing.s3: Optionally add the customer's name / a note.
help.t.dynamicPricing.s5: Click 'Create link' → share the URL via WhatsApp / SMS.
help.t.dynamicPricing.tip0: Each link is single-use: once a customer orders, it flips to 'USED' and can't be re-used.
help.t.dynamicPricing.tip1: Click 'Mark inactive' on a card to invalidate a link before it's redeemed.
help.t.createOrder.title: Creating an order manually
help.t.createOrder.summary: Useful for orders received outside the app (WhatsApp, walk-in).
help.t.createOrder.s1: Pick a product, set quantity, enter customer name, mobile, and address.
help.t.createOrder.s2: Optionally add comments / shipping vendor / tracking ID.
help.t.createOrder.s3: Save. The order shows up in the list.
help.t.orderStatusFlow.title: Order status flow — what each state means
help.t.orderStatusFlow.summary: PENDING → CONFIRMED → SHIPPED → DELIVERED. Plus the side paths: CANCELLED / DELIVERY_FAILED / REFUND.
help.t.orderStatusFlow.s0: PENDING (default): order received, not yet acted on.
help.t.orderStatusFlow.s1: CONFIRMED: you've reviewed and accepted it.
help.t.orderStatusFlow.s2: SHIPPED: parcel handed to a carrier. Requires shipping vendor + tracking ID. Payment must be 'Paid' first.
help.t.orderStatusFlow.s3: DELIVERED: customer received it. Requires shipping vendor on file.
help.t.orderStatusFlow.s4: DELIVERY_FAILED: post-ship, the parcel didn't reach. Enables 'REFUND' on the payment side.
help.t.orderStatusFlow.s5: CANCELLED: pre-ship cancellation. Disabled once shipping details are set — use DELIVERY_FAILED instead.
help.t.orderStatusFlow.tip0: DELIVERED is locked once you save it — it's a terminal state.
help.t.orderStatusFlow.tip1: When you change to a status like SHIPPED, a confirmation dialog summarises every change before saving.
help.t.editOrder.title: Editing an order
help.t.editOrder.summary: Update customer details, status, payment, shipping.
help.t.editOrder.s0: Open an order from the Orders list.
help.t.editOrder.s1: Edit any unlocked field — name, phone, address, comments, status.
help.t.editOrder.s2: If you select status SHIPPED, the Shipping section reveals — fill carrier + tracking ID.
help.t.editOrder.s3: Click 'Save changes' → confirm in the popup → done.
help.t.editOrder.tip0: Quantity, unit price, cost, and product can't be edited — those are the financial truth of the order. To fix, cancel and recreate.
help.t.shareTrackingLink.title: Sharing a tracking link with a customer
help.t.shareTrackingLink.summary: Two formats — direct deep-link, or a form they can paste into.
help.t.shareTrackingLink.s0: Direct deep-link: /track/<order.publicToken> — opens the customer straight to the order.
help.t.shareTrackingLink.s1: Form page: /track — customer types their order ID (case-insensitive).
help.t.shareTrackingLink.s3: Customer copies the AWB and clicks 'Open tracking page' to land on the carrier's site.
help.t.shareTrackingLink.tip0: If you copy a deep-link, customer doesn't need to know the order ID — they just open the URL.
help.t.shareTrackingLink.tip1: If you only have the order ID (e.g. SMS receipt), use the pre-filled form URL.
help.t.carrierTrackingUrls.title: How carrier tracking URLs work
help.t.carrierTrackingUrls.summary: We store URL templates per carrier in the backend — substituting {trackingId} when a customer clicks.
help.t.carrierTrackingUrls.s0: When you mark an order SHIPPED with a vendor + tracking ID, both are saved.
help.t.carrierTrackingUrls.s1: On the tracking page, the customer's 'Open tracking page' button reads the saved vendor and substitutes the tracking ID into the carrier's URL template.
help.t.carrierTrackingUrls.s2: Templates are seeded for 15 Indian carriers (Blue Dart, DTDC, Delhivery, India Post, FedEx, etc.).
help.t.carrierTrackingUrls.tip0: If a carrier changes their tracking URL, ops can update the template via SQL — no redeploy needed.
help.t.connectWhatsapp.title: Connecting your WhatsApp account
help.t.connectWhatsapp.summary: Scan a QR with your phone — works exactly like WhatsApp Web.
help.t.connectWhatsapp.s1: Click 'Connect WhatsApp'. The page polls every 3 seconds while the session starts.
help.t.connectWhatsapp.s2: When the QR appears, open WhatsApp on your phone → Settings → Linked Devices → Link a Device → scan the QR.
help.t.connectWhatsapp.s3: Status flips to 'Connected' once the link succeeds.
help.t.connectWhatsapp.s4: Use the 'Send a test message' card to confirm everything works.
help.t.connectWhatsapp.tip0: If the QR is stuck or your phone says 'Could not link this device', click 'Generate new QR' — it restarts the WAHA session and produces a fresh QR.
help.t.connectWhatsapp.tip1: WAHA Core supports one WhatsApp account at a time. Multi-account requires WAHA Plus.
help.t.whatsappSendMessage.title: Sending a WhatsApp message
help.t.whatsappSendMessage.summary: Test from settings, or wire it into your order flow.
help.t.whatsappSendMessage.s0: Once connected, the WhatsApp page shows a 'Send a test message' card.
help.t.whatsappSendMessage.s1: Enter the recipient with country code (e.g. 919999999999 for India).
help.t.whatsappSendMessage.s2: Type the message → click Send → toast confirms delivery to WAHA.
help.t.whatsappSendMessage.tip0: Avoid bulk / spammy messaging — WhatsApp can ban the number.
help.t.whatsappSendMessage.tip1: For real customer messaging, the WhatsApp Business Cloud API (official) is more reliable for scale.
help.t.paymentMethodOnline.title: Online payment (manual)
help.t.paymentMethodOnline.summary: Take payment outside the app — Razorpay, PayPal, etc.
help.t.paymentMethodOnline.s2: Buyers see 'Online payment' at checkout — handle the transfer through your own gateway.
help.t.paymentMethodUpiQr.title: UPI QR code
help.t.paymentMethodUpiQr.summary: Show your UPI QR; buyers scan and pay directly.
help.t.paymentMethodUpiQr.s1: Click the upload box → pick a screenshot of your UPI QR (PNG / JPG).
help.t.paymentMethodUpiQr.s2: A preview appears. Click 'Save payment method'.
help.t.paymentMethodUpiQr.s3: After save, the saved QR shows on your settings page on every visit. To replace it, just upload a new image and save.
help.t.paymentMethodUpiQr.tip0: Take the QR screenshot from your UPI app's 'Receive money' / 'My QR' screen — make sure it's clear and your name shows.
help.t.paymentMethodBank.title: Bank account
help.t.paymentMethodBank.summary: Direct bank transfer details. Encrypted at rest, masked in the UI.
help.t.paymentMethodBank.s1: Enter your account number twice (re-entered for verification).
help.t.paymentMethodBank.s2: Enter the IFSC code (11 chars, e.g. HDFC0001234). The bank name and branch resolve automatically via Razorpay's IFSC lookup.
help.t.paymentMethodBank.s4: After save, the page shows '•••• 1234' (masked tail) and the IFSC. The full account number is encrypted at rest and never displayed again — re-enter to update.
help.t.paymentMethodBank.tip0: If the IFSC lookup says 'Couldn't find a bank for this IFSC', double-check the format — letters are uppercase, the 5th character is always 0.
help.t.paymentMethodBank.tip1: We never echo your full account number back from the API. Even our own admins can't read it without database + encryption-key access.
help.t.smartPricing.title: Smart Pricing
help.t.smartPricing.summary: Get four price ideas — break-even, safe, aggressive, premium — plus a one-line AI strategy for each.
help.t.smartPricing.s1: Enter the cost details for the product you're pricing.
help.t.smartPricing.s2: Click 'Calculate' — the app shows four prices.
help.t.smartPricing.s3: Apply any of them as your selling price by clicking through to the product editor.

help.t.profitHealth.s1: Enter monthly sales and total expenses.
help.t.profitHealth.s2: Score, margin %, profit ₹, and concrete next-step suggestions appear.

help.t.settingsProfile.s1: Edit store name, contact phone, language.
help.t.settingsProfile.tip0: Phone is the same one captured at onboarding — used for support and order-status SMS.
help.t.settingsLanguage.title: Changing language
help.t.settingsLanguage.summary: 9 languages: English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Kannada, Gujarati, Malayalam.
help.t.settingsLanguage.s2: Click Save. Every page re-renders in the new language immediately.
help.t.settingsTheme.title: Theme and accent colour
help.t.settingsTheme.s2: Pick an accent — Emerald, Sky, Violet, Rose, Amber.
help.t.settingsTheme.s3: Click Save. Preference syncs across devices.
help.t.growthAdvisor.title: Growth Advisor
help.t.growthAdvisor.summary: Six personalised AI suggestions every week.
help.t.growthAdvisor.s1: AI scans your products / orders / pricing and surfaces six concrete actions.
help.t.growthAdvisor.s2: Mark a suggestion as 'Done' once you've acted on it — keeps the list fresh next week.
help.t.growthAdvisor.tip0: Suggestions are prioritised — the top one usually has the highest expected impact.
help.t.aiKeysOverview.title: Saathi AI — overview and key choices
help.t.aiKeysOverview.summary: Pick one (or more) free LLM providers, paste the key in Settings, and start chatting on /chat. Fallback handling is automatic.
help.t.aiKeysOverview.s0: Open Settings → 'Saathi AI keys' and paste a key for at least one provider.
help.t.aiKeysOverview.s1: Choose a primary provider — the assistant tries it first on every message.
help.t.aiKeysOverview.s2: If the primary call fails (bad key, daily limit, network), the next configured provider is tried automatically.
help.t.aiKeysOverview.s3: Go to Saathi AI in the sidebar (/chat). Upload a product photo or type a question.
help.t.aiKeysOverview.s4: Daily limits: 20 text messages, 5 image uploads, per seller. Resets at midnight IST.
help.t.aiKeysOverview.tip0: Keys never appear in browser code — they're sent over HTTPS, stored AES-256 encrypted on the server.
help.t.aiKeysOverview.tip1: Adding all three providers gives the most reliable experience: when one is rate-limited, the next picks up.
help.t.aiKeyGemini.title: Get a Google Gemini API key (free)
help.t.aiKeyGemini.summary: Best free option — multimodal, generous quota. Takes 60 seconds with a Google account.
help.t.aiKeyGemini.s0: Visit aistudio.google.com/apikey and sign in with the Google account you want to use.
help.t.aiKeyGemini.s1: Click 'Create API key'. Pick the default project unless you have a reason to choose another.
help.t.aiKeyGemini.s2: Copy the key — it starts with 'AIza…'. Treat it like a password.
help.t.aiKeyGemini.s3: In ProfitSaathi, open Settings → Saathi AI keys → paste into the Google Gemini row → Save.
help.t.aiKeyGemini.tip0: If the page asks you to enable billing, you can skip it — the free tier on 'gemini-2.5-flash' is enough.
help.t.aiKeyGemini.tip1: Revoke any time from the same page if you suspect a key has been leaked. Then paste a new one in Settings.
help.t.aiKeyOpenrouter.title: Get an OpenRouter API key (free models available)
help.t.aiKeyOpenrouter.summary: OpenRouter routes to many open-weight LLMs. Free vision models are available on its free tier.
help.t.aiKeyOpenrouter.s0: Visit openrouter.ai and sign up — email or Google works.
help.t.aiKeyOpenrouter.s1: Go to openrouter.ai/keys → 'Create Key'. Give it a name like 'profitsaathi'.
help.t.aiKeyOpenrouter.s2: Copy the key — it starts with 'sk-or-v1-…'.
help.t.aiKeyOpenrouter.s3: In ProfitSaathi, paste into the OpenRouter row in Settings → Saathi AI keys → Save.
help.t.aiKeyOpenrouter.tip0: Some free models have daily caps — if you hit one, the assistant falls back to your other configured providers automatically.
help.t.aiKeyOpenrouter.tip1: Don't share or commit your key. Anyone with it can use your account's free quota.
help.t.aiKeyNvidia.title: Get an NVIDIA NIM API key (free credits)
help.t.aiKeyNvidia.summary: NVIDIA NIM hosts large vision models like Llama 3.2 90B Vision. Free credits when you register.
help.t.aiKeyNvidia.s0: Visit build.nvidia.com and sign in (free NVIDIA developer account).
help.t.aiKeyNvidia.s2: Click 'Get API key'. The key starts with 'nvapi-…'.
help.t.aiKeyNvidia.s4: In ProfitSaathi, paste into the NVIDIA NIM row in Settings → Saathi AI keys → Save.
help.t.aiKeyNvidia.tip0: Credits are pooled across NIM models. The chat uses 'llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct' by default.
help.t.aiKeyNvidia.tip1: If you run out of credits, the assistant falls back to your other configured providers.
